additional_info.subject: Error Description
additional_info.body:
Good day everyone, there have been increasing problems at the charging station where a cable was replaced in the spring (responsible at that time was Mr. Rudols Artes).
For example, charging processes are stopping after a short period of time or, as in the last case, are being ended on a timer. Since August 7th, the status in the backend shows 'charging process is being ended.' I have tried to end the charging process remotely via the backend and have already been in contact with our backend operator regarding this issue, but unfortunately nothing can be done here. Control unit: 8EM5903-0AA04-0AA0 We suspect that this may possibly be related to the cable replacement. Has a recalibration been carried out on the station since then? Is there a possibility for you to remotely access the charging station and take a closer look at the problem? I could possibly provide you with a diagnostic file from our backend if that would be helpful. Or the existing email correspondence with Mr. Artes.
